name: nicetry/tarpit
description: Tarpits: make the worst bots wait. Clients a rule puts in a tarpit, gym no-shows, and clients the edge catches collecting 404s or sending bursts get a free try, then wait longer each request (2 s, 8 s, 24 s… up to 30 s) at the edge, with a cap on how many are held at once.
